title: the MotP Plane of Elemental Fire
audit_comment: the Plane of Elemental Fire, printed pp. 36-41, the whole chapter: the hellish-plane doctrine with the four border gradations (Smoke, Magma, Radiance, Ash), the survival ladder (the breath-save-or-die with 4d10 per round survivors, the melting metal, the boiling fluids, the thin hot atmosphere with cloudkill effects), the 120-foot vision, the 1-in-10-per-eight-hours check, the d12 phenomena (hot spots with their native healing, cold spots, the 2,000-yard eruption, the explosion field), the d20 pocket table (the purest plane), the d8+d12 encounter chart, the native cold/water vulnerabilities (the 100-degree threshold, 1d6 per quart), the magic rule, and the features (Imix the paranoid archoment, Kossuth the tyrant-king, the efreet City of Brass, the azer towers of Amaimon, and the spiraling-flame artifact).

banner.title: THE MotP PLANE OF ELEMENTAL FIRE - printed pp. 36-41, the whole chapter in one round: the survival ladder, the phenomena, the pockets, the encounter chart, and the features (Imix, Kossuth, the City of Brass, the azer, the spiraling flame).
banner.provenance: verified against printed pp. 36-41 of the uploaded motp.pdf OCR; the survival ladder and the native vulnerability thresholds are the MotP's own text, pinned plane-by-plane per the R567 doctrine frame.
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 28 closed, 62 open - three boxes fall (the plane, the phenomena table, the pocket table); Earth is next.

consts.name: dcxFireEncounterDenom
consts.comment: travelers in the plane of Fire have a 1-in-10 chance of an encounter every eight hours; roll: 1-15 elemental phenomena, 16-20 elemental pocket, 21-00 creature encounter.

consts.name: dcxFirePhenomenaDieSides
consts.comment: the d12 phenomena table: hot spot (1-4), cold spot (5-7), rain of ashes, smoke cloud, eruption, explosion field, and the vortex to a Prime Material plane.

consts.name: dcxFirePocketTableDie
consts.comment: the d20 pocket table - the plane of Fire is the purest of the four majors (hostile to pockets): air 1-3, earth 4-6, smoke 7-9, magma 10-12, and the rare survivors through water/ooze/ice at 20.

consts.name: dcxFireChartDieSides
consts.comment: the Fire encounter chart is a d8+d12 roll (2-20): 2 Imix (the archoment), 10 the azer, 11 the efreeti, 13 the salamanders, 40-400 flame goblins - the 2 and 20 unique-powers slots.

consts.name: dcxFireHeatDamageRounds
consts.comment: the survival ladder: unprotected beings save vs. breath weapons or die, survivors take 4d10 per round (1d10 with a natural nonmetal AC 2+ and a +2 save bonus); flammables burn their wearer for 3d6; nonmagical metal melts in two rounds (heat metal then 3d10); the thin hot atmosphere deals 1d10 per round and cloudkill effects to the unprotected.

consts.name: dcxFireVisionFeet
consts.comment: vision is limited to 120 feet in the misty, translucent brilliance; smoked glass or quartz lenses double the sighting distance; infravision finds non-natives as cooler spots but not natives against the flame background.

consts.name: dcxFireNativeColdDamageDie
consts.comment: the native vulnerability: temperatures below 100 degrees Fahrenheit deal 1d2 per round to a creature of elemental fire; water and ice spells deal 1d6 per quart of water used; natives are immune to fire/heat throughout the inner planes.

consts.name: dcxFireCityMiles
consts.comment: the City of Brass: 40 miles across, its base a hemisphere of golden glowing brass, the Sultan's Palace in the citadel towers, bordered by magma seas and lava lakes - the grand sultan a Greater Power, advised by six great pashas for Prime business.

bools.name: dcxFireBordersGrade
bools.comment: the border gradations: burnable haze and soot toward Smoke, basalt and flowing rock toward Magma, brightening flame toward Radiance, and dying fires with bone-chilling cold toward Ash.

bools.name: dcxFireHotSpotHeal
bools.comment: the hot spot: double fire damage and -1 saves for non-natives, but Fire natives regain 1d6 hit points per turn within; cold spots are sanctuaries near Prime desert temperatures where water and flammables can exist.

bools.name: dcxFireEruptionRange
bools.comment: the eruption: a moving sphere of flame spurting about 2,000 yards, hot-spot effects plus 2d6 debris damage; the explosion field adds 4d12 physical damage when tripped; the vortex opens in lakes of lava or volcano hearts.

bools.name: dcxFireMagicElementRule
bools.comment: the magic rule: created materials are immediately affected by the plane (create water turns to steam in one round), spells cannot affect what does not exist (move earth needs an earth pocket), control winds and control weather fail in the thin atmosphere outside air pockets.

bools.name: dcxFireSpiralFlame
bools.comment: the spiraling flame, the plane-unique artifact: save vs. spell or be charmed and immobile, drawn in within 1-6 rounds, containerized and cast into another plane like an efreet in a bottle - only ally rescue frees the victim; it cannot leave the plane of Fire.
